title: Menkauhor
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 12 (Egypt Dynasty 5).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 5. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 12, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 5"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
